answerable.q: Is an Incorporated Joint Venture Company (IJVC) subject to the Fiscal Responsibility Act and the Public Procurement Act?
answerable.a: No — paragraph 2 of the Second Schedule states no IJVC shall be subject to either Act.
answerable.citation: Petroleum Industry Act, 2021, SECOND SCHEDULE, paragraph 2

answerable.q: Under what authority does the Board of NNPC Limited perform its duties?
answerable.a: In accordance with the Petroleum Industry Act, the Companies and Allied Matters Act, and NNPC Limited's own articles of association (Section 58).

answerable.q: Who pays the remuneration and allowances of Commissioners of the Nigerian Upstream Petroleum Regulatory Commission, and what must it comply with?
answerable.a: They are paid from the Commission's own funds, and the remuneration must comply with the policy and guidelines of the National Salaries, Incomes and Wages Commission (Section 13).

answerable.q: Can a gas transportation network operator licence include an obligation to develop market rules?
answerable.a: Yes — Section 141(1) allows this as an additional condition on a transportation network operator licence.

answerable.q: What is one thing the Authority's regulations for midstream and downstream gas operations may include, under Section 126?
answerable.a: The establishment and operation of a wholesale natural gas market scheme to ensure continuity of supply to customers.

answerable.q: What law governs compensation for land acquired for midstream and downstream petroleum operations?
answerable.a: The Land Use Act, per Section 115(1).

answerable.q: What exclusive right does a holder of a petroleum prospecting licence have under Section 72?
answerable.a: The exclusive right to drill exploration and appraisal wells within the licence area (with a non-exclusive right to carry out petroleum exploration operations generally).

answerable.q: Within what timeframe after the PIA's commencement was the Minister required to incorporate NNPC Limited?
answerable.a: Within six months from the commencement of the Act (Section 53(1)).

answerable.q: Under the Fifth Schedule, when is a building, structure or works of a permanent nature considered 'disposed of'?
answerable.a: Among other triggers listed in paragraph 10: when the relevant interest is sold, or when a concession-dependent interest ends at the end of that concession.
answerable.citation: Petroleum Industry Act, 2021, FIFTH SCHEDULE, paragraph 10

answerable.q: How soon after the start of an accounting period must an upstream crude oil company submit an estimated return of profits for hydrocarbon tax purposes?
answerable.a: Not later than two months after the commencement of the accounting period (Section 280(1)).

answerable.q: By when must the Authority present its statement of estimated income and expenditure to the National Assembly?
answerable.a: Not later than 30th September each year, or another date set by the Minister responsible for Budget and National Planning (Section 45(1)).

answerable.q: Does the Petroleum Industry Act apply to holders of an oil prospecting licence or mining lease who have not entered a conversion contract?
answerable.a: Generally no, per Section 303(1) — except for section 311 and paragraphs 10 and 11 of the Seventh Schedule, which apply to licences and leases awarded to indigenous Nigerian companies.

answerable.q: What may the Commission or Authority do when a lease, licence or permit holder is contravening its conditions, under Section 217?
answerable.a: It may publish a notice, in a manner it considers appropriate, to draw the attention of other persons affected or likely to be affected by the contravention.

answerable.q: How is a vacancy on the Board of the Commission filled?
answerable.a: By appointing another person in accordance with section 11 of the Act (Section 17).

answerable.q: Name one circumstance under which a vacancy on the Board of the Commission occurs.
answerable.a: Among others listed in Section 16: the commissioner dies, resigns, completes tenure, is removed under section 14, or is incapacitated.

answerable.q: Must a government ministry consult the Authority before issuing a regulation that could affect midstream or downstream petroleum operations?
answerable.a: Yes — Section 48(1) requires such consultation before issuing any regulation, guideline, enforcement order or directive with direct impact on those operations.

answerable.q: What must the Authority do when an application for a licence grant or renewal is made, under Section 112?
answerable.a: Publish a notification of the application in a manner prescribed by regulation.

answerable.q: Name one ground on which a licence or permit may be revoked under Section 120.
answerable.a: One ground is that the holder becomes insolvent or bankrupt, or goes into liquidation (except as part of a scheme of arrangement or amalgamation).

answerable.q: Which body is responsible for assessing and collecting hydrocarbon tax under Section 259?
answerable.a: The Federal Inland Revenue Service (the Service).

answerable.q: If another law conflicts with the Petroleum Industry Act, which prevails, and what is the notable exception?
answerable.a: The PIA prevails, except for the Nigeria Oil and Gas Industry Content Development Act (Section 309).

answerable.q: Give one ground under Section 14 for the President to suspend or remove a member of the Commission's Board.
answerable.a: One ground is that the member is found unqualified for appointment under section 11, or becomes unqualified after appointment.

answerable.q: Where can a taxpayer appeal a tax assessment made under Section 285(6) of the PIA?
answerable.a: To the Tax Appeal Tribunal established under section 59 of the Federal Inland Revenue Service (Establishment) Act (Section 288).

answerable.q: Within what timeframe must a licensee submit an environmental management plan requiring environmental impact assessment?
answerable.a: Within one year of the effective date, or six months after the grant of the applicable licence or lease (Section 102(1)).

answerable.q: What royalty rate applies to onshore crude oil and condensate production under the Seventh Schedule?
answerable.a: 15% of the chargeable volume (shallow water is 12.5%, deep offshore and frontier basins are 7.5%), per paragraph 10(2).
answerable.citation: Petroleum Industry Act, 2021, SEVENTH SCHEDULE, paragraph 10

answerable.q: How must an IJVC pay dividends to its shareholders, under the Second Schedule?
answerable.a: Pro rata among the number of issued shares held directly by shareholders, subject to any applicable withholding tax (paragraph 7).
answerable.citation: Petroleum Industry Act, 2021, SECOND SCHEDULE, paragraph 7

answerable.q: What must be paid before a petroleum prospecting licence or mining lease can be granted?
answerable.a: The applicable fees, signature bonus, and first-year rent (Seventh Schedule, paragraph 3(1)).
answerable.citation: Petroleum Industry Act, 2021, SEVENTH SCHEDULE, paragraph 3

answerable.q: What power does the Authority have when it believes a prohibited act is likely to be undertaken, under Section 215?
answerable.a: It may serve a notice on the person specifying the act and its intention to issue a 'cease and desist' order.

answerable.q: What must the Authority ensure regarding third-party access under Section 113?
answerable.a: Third-party access to facilities and pipelines for midstream and downstream petroleum operations.

answerable.q: Name one offence under Section 230 relating to information given to the Commission or Authority.
answerable.a: Furnishing a false or incomplete return, or supplying false or incomplete information.

answerable.q: Besides the Petroleum Industry Act, what other tax law applies to companies engaged in petroleum operations?
answerable.a: The Companies Income Tax Act (Section 302(1)).

answerable.q: What general obligation does a wholesale gas supplier have toward customers under a gas purchase agreement, per Section 143?
answerable.a: To provide a reliable supply of wholesale gas to wholesale customers who have entered into a gas purchase and sale agreement with the supplier.

answerable.q: What is the legal status of the Nigerian Upstream Petroleum Regulatory Commission under Section 4?
answerable.a: A body corporate with perpetual succession and a common seal, able to acquire, hold and dispose of property and to sue and be sued in its own name.

answerable.q: What exclusive rights does a lessee under a petroleum mining lease have, per Section 82?
answerable.a: The exclusive right to carry out development and production of petroleum in the lease area, and to drill exploration and appraisal wells there.

answerable.q: What must the Commission publish regarding licence applications, per paragraph 1 of the Seventh Schedule?
answerable.a: The rates or fees payable for licence-related applications, such as a petroleum exploration licence application or a petroleum mining lease renewal.
answerable.citation: Petroleum Industry Act, 2021, SEVENTH SCHEDULE, paragraph 1

answerable.q: How is the value of blended crude oil, condensates, or natural gas liquids determined?
answerable.a: At the measurement points, adjusted for transport costs within Nigeria (Regulation 28).

answerable.q: When may the Commission make an occasional determination of fiscal oil or gas price, under Regulation 22?
answerable.a: Where required for valuing test production or for other occasional purposes, including a lack of complete information from the lessee.

answerable.q: How is the average BTU production content of natural gas determined for a given month?
answerable.a: By dividing the total heating value measured by the approved gas calorimeter that month by the total volume of gas produced that month (Regulation 18).

answerable.q: What may a lessee do if insufficient natural gas is produced in a PML for production or injection needs?
answerable.a: Purchase the required natural gas, or transfer natural gas from another PML for that purpose (Regulation 10).

answerable.q: What must a lessee provide when a field straddles onshore and shallow water terrain, under Regulation 14?
answerable.a: Information on the volumes produced in each respective terrain, so a weighted average royalty rate can be calculated.

answerable.q: How does Regulation 47 define 'arm's length'?
answerable.a: As a relationship between two or more persons where none exerts, or is positioned to exert, significant influence over the others, having regard to all relevant factors.

answerable.q: Can a lessee produce petroleum from a PML without approved petroleum measurement meters installed?
answerable.a: No — Regulation 7(1) requires Commission-approved measurement meters to be installed before production.

answerable.q: Are by-products such as helium or sulphur subject to royalty under the PIA?
answerable.a: No — Regulation 6(2) states petroleum by-products, including helium or sulphur, are not subject to royalty.

answerable.q: Can a holder of an interest in a Permit to Access Flare Gas transfer that interest freely?
answerable.a: No — Regulation 13(1) requires the prior consent of the Commission before transferring, selling, assigning, or mortgaging any part of such an interest.
answerable.citation: Gas Flaring, Venting and Methane Emissions (Prevention of Waste and Pollution) Regulations, 2023, Regulation 13

answerable.q: How long does a licensee have to comply with a Commission request for Gas Data?
answerable.a: 30 days from receiving the notice, unless the Commission extends the time on request (Regulation 4).
answerable.citation: Gas Flaring, Venting and Methane Emissions (Prevention of Waste and Pollution) Regulations, 2023, Regulation 4

answerable.q: Under what two conditions is gas flaring allowed outside of emergencies, per Regulation 12?
answerable.a: The flaring must be within the Commission-approved threshold, and a flaring fee must be paid.
answerable.citation: Gas Flaring, Venting and Methane Emissions (Prevention of Waste and Pollution) Regulations, 2023, Regulation 12

answerable.q: What is the short title of the 2023 regulation governing gas flaring, venting and methane emissions?
answerable.a: The Gas Flaring, Venting and Methane Emissions (Prevention of Waste and Pollution) Regulations, 2023 (Regulation 28).
answerable.citation: Gas Flaring, Venting and Methane Emissions (Prevention of Waste and Pollution) Regulations, 2023, Regulation 28

answerable.q: How often must a producer of gas submit its daily flaring and venting log to the Commission?
answerable.a: Within 21 days following the end of each month (Regulation 20).
answerable.citation: Gas Flaring, Venting and Methane Emissions (Prevention of Waste and Pollution) Regulations, 2023, Regulation 20

answerable.q: What happens if a licensee fails to resubmit an abandonment application and the Commission believes the well needs abandoning, under Regulation 9?
answerable.a: The Commission shall appoint a third party to carry out the abandonment of the well.
answerable.citation: Nigeria Upstream Petroleum Decommissioning and Abandonment Regulations, 2023, Regulation 9

answerable.q: What is the citation title of the 2023 Nigerian decommissioning regulation?
answerable.a: The Nigeria Upstream Decommissioning and Abandonment Regulations, 2023 (Regulation 26).
answerable.citation: Nigeria Upstream Petroleum Decommissioning and Abandonment Regulations, 2023, Regulation 26

answerable.q: What do the Decommissioning and Abandonment Regulations apply to, under Regulation 2?
answerable.a: The decommissioning and abandonment of facilities used in upstream petroleum operations in Nigeria, and associated wells, installations and facilities under a licence or lease.
answerable.citation: Nigeria Upstream Petroleum Decommissioning and Abandonment Regulations, 2023, Regulation 2

answerable.q: What is the administrative penalty for a licensee who fails to submit a decommissioning and abandonment plan on time?
answerable.a: USD$500,000 for every year of non-compliance, payable to the Commission (or revocation of the licence/lease interest) — Regulation 24.
answerable.citation: Nigeria Upstream Petroleum Decommissioning and Abandonment Regulations, 2023, Regulation 24

answerable.q: How soon after completing decommissioning and abandonment must a licensee notify the Commission?
answerable.a: Within six months of completion (Regulation 15).
answerable.citation: Nigeria Upstream Petroleum Decommissioning and Abandonment Regulations, 2023, Regulation 15
